newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong group shrs make strong gains.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong group shrs make strong gains.

text.p: Shares in Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd, Cheung Kong Infrastructure Holdings Ltd, Hutchison Whampoa Ltd and Hongkong Electric Holdings Ltd resumed trading on Tuesday with strong gains.
Shares in Cheung Kong surged HK$5.25 in early trade to HK$73.00 following the announcement of a reshuffle in the group on Monday.
Hutchison was up HK$3.00 at HK$61.50 while Hongkong Electric rose HK$2.40 to HK$27.65 and Cheung Kong Infrastructure gained HK$2.05 to HK$23.20.
Trading in Cheung Kong, Hutchison, Hongkong Electric and Cheung Kong Infrastructure (CKI) was suspended on Monday due to the announcement of the reshuffle.
Hutchison plans to make a general offer for Hongkong Electric and then transfer its stake in the utility to Cheung Kong Infrastructure (CKI) in exchange for new CKI shares.
Cheung Kong will also transfer its existing shareholding of 70.66 percent in CKI to Hutchison for about HK$20.45 billion.
"I think Cheung Kong is a clear winner," said Alan Hutcheson, director of research at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
